draft.subject: One next step for River Systems
draft.body:
Hi Felix,

Nice work getting your first project up in week one. Since projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, the usual next step is filling that project out with real tasks so the week's work actually lives in Wrenfield -- and bringing someone else in, since a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through whichever of those two is more useful for River Systems and answer anything that's come up.

Best,
Priya
